decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a mixture of aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. The main goal is to establish board control through early aggression and efficient removal spells, while also utilizing the power of the deck's legendary creatures to maintain momentum and pressure. The deck aims to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize, using a combination of creature swarm and burn spells to secure victory. The inclusion of cards like Ajani, Guide of Souls and Seasoned Pyromancer provides additional value and card advantage to maintain pressure on the opponent.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with cards like Arboreal Grazer and Explore to cast Primeval Titan, searching for powerful lands like Gruul Turf and Urza's Saga. The key strategy is to create a loop of generating mana with Amulet of Vigor and bouncing lands with cards like Gruul Turf, allowing for explosive plays with cards like Scapeshift. This combo-oriented deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with massive land drops and powerful creatures, ultimately overwhelming them with a strong board presence and lethal attacks.

The key concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan and control the board with a wide array of removal, counterspells, and disruptive creatures like Murktide Regent and Abhorrent Oculus. The deck aims to outvalue opponents by making efficient trades and efficiently answering threats while generating card advantage through Thought Scour and Consider. The deck also utilizes graveyard recursion with Unearth to bring back key creatures. This control deck looks to dominate the late game through card advantage and powerful threats while keeping opponents on the back foot.

This deck aims to control the game early on by ramping up mana with cards like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple, while also using powerful Eldrazi creatures to dominate the board. The deck utilizes cards like Kozilek's Command and Kozilek's Return for removal and disruption, while also having options for card draw and protection with cards like Ancient Stirrings and Talisman of Impulse. The key strategy is to quickly ramp into big Eldrazi threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker, overwhelming opponents with powerful creatures and disruptive spells.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling a powerful board presence by utilizing creature-based combos and synergies. By combining creatures like Basking Broodscale and Glaring Fleshraker with equipment like Blade of the Bloodchief, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents with large threats. Emrakul, the Promised End serves as a powerful finisher, and cards like Walking Ballista and Kozilek's Command provide additional utility and removal. With a mix of powerful creatures, support spells, and utility lands like Urza's Saga, the deck aims to disrupt opponents while establishing a dominant board presence.

The key concept of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful Eldrazi creatures and disrupt their game plan with cards like Chalice of the Void and Kozilek's Command. The deck aims to control the board with efficient creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Sire of Seven Deaths while applying pressure with Eldrazi Linebreaker and Wastescape Battlemage. The deck also utilizes cards like Ugin, Eye of the Storms for additional power and resilience. With a mix of disruption, aggression, and strong creatures, this deck aims to dominate the battlefield and secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponent's mana base with the help of Blood Moon and Utopia Sprawl, while controlling the board through removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Anger of the Gods. Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility and disruption. The creatures in the deck are efficient beaters like Bloodbraid Elf, Bonecrusher Giant, and Fanatic of Rhonas. Seasoned Pyromancer provides card advantage, while Endurance disrupts opponent's graveyard strategies. The deck also includes mana ramp with Arbor Elf and efficient lands to support the powerful cards in the deck.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively play creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Monastery Swiftspear, while using cheap spells like Lava Dart and Lightning Bolt to control the board. Mishra's Bauble provides card advantage, while Slickshot Show-Off and Cori-Steel Cutter offer additional threats. The deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently through a mix of creature combat and burn spells, with cards like Mutagenic Growth and Violent Urge providing extra reach. Expressive Iteration and Preordain help ensure consistency in drawing the right cards for the aggressive game plan.

This aggro-affinity deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent by deploying a swarm of artifact creatures and using cards like Springleaf Drum and Mox Opal to power them out quickly. Michiko's Reign of Truth and Memory Guardian provide additional card advantage and disruption, while Sink into Stupor can help control the opponent's board. The deck also utilizes Urza's Saga to tutor for key artifacts like Portable Hole and Shadowspear. With a mix of creatures, equipment, and disruption spells, this deck aims to be a fast and aggressive threat in the Modern format.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Static Prison and Arena of Glory while utilizing creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ocelot Pride to deal quick damage. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls provide additional support for the creature strategy, while versatile cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Voice of Victory add flexibility to the deck's game plan. Overall, the deck seeks to apply pressure early and maintain it throughout the game.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with efficient and aggressive creatures, utilizing cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to quickly close out the game. The deck also aims to control the board with cards like Static Prison and Goblin Bombardment, while also supporting its aggressive strategy with cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Guide of Souls. The mana base is tailored to ensure consistent access to both white and red mana sources, allowing for a smooth and powerful gameplay experience.

This deck focuses on a combination of aggressive creatures and cards that allow for blinking and reusing their abilities. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Aether Vial, along with creatures like Flickerwisp and Overlord of the Balemurk, the deck aims to constantly disrupt the opponent's board while also applying pressure with its creatures. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Prismatic Ending to control the board. Overall, the strategy lies in quickly developing a threatening board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan through blinking effects.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of countermagic, removal spells, and powerful creatures. The deck aims to answer threats efficiently while also gradually building advantage through card draw and resource denial. By utilizing a mix of disruptive spells like Fatal Push and Counterspell, along with powerful finishers like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares, the deck aims to outlast opponents and secure victory through attrition and strategic play.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Talisman of Impulse and Utopia Sprawl to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. It also utilizes control elements such as Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large creatures while also having the ability to control the board and protect itself with cards like Writhing Chrysalis and Devourer of Destiny. The inclusion of cards like Ancient Stirrings and Ugin, Eye of the Storms also provide additional utility and card advantage.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures while controlling the opponent's actions through various spells and abilities. It utilizes cards like Sowing Mycospawn and Writhing Chrysalis to create tokens and slow down the opponent's strategy, supplemented by removal spells like Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble. The goal is to overpower the opponent with big threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ugin, Eye of the Storms, while using Eldrazi Temple and Ugin's Labyrinth to generate extra mana and protect key pieces.

The deck revolves around utilizing powerful combo pieces such as Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Kethis, the Hidden Hand to generate multiple loops of card advantage and mana acceleration. By combining various legendary spells with artifacts like Mox Opal and Mishra's Bauble, the player aims to quickly assemble a board state that can outvalue and outpace the opponent. Cards like Grinding Station and Malevolent Rumble provide additional win conditions and disruption, while the deck's land base includes utility lands like Urza's Saga and Boseiju, Who Endures to further support the combo strategy.
